semanticConstraints: ClientSecret must be nonblank for the confidential BFF profile; configured secret values are never emitted.
CallbackPath, SignedOutCallbackPath, RemoteSignOutPath and AccessDeniedPath must be distinct ignoring case and must not replace the fixed BFF session endpoints.

All four callback/access-denied paths must be literal local absolute paths without trailing slash, repeated slash, dot-segments, whitespace/control characters, escaping, query, fragment or route parameters.
Native OIDC/cookie options also validate their protocol-specific requirements; the exporter never starts handlers or contacts identity services.
RemoteAuthenticationTimeoutSeconds must be positive and is validated on shell composition before lazy OIDC handler activation.

LogoutLandingPath is a bounded literal shell-relative path, expanded with the request PathBase for both provider completion and initiation failure. It must not replace protocol callbacks, API or BFF control endpoints; /bff/signed-out remains the default machine acknowledgement. The application owns an anonymous browser landing and independently observes session state.

The default interactive sign-in window is 900 seconds; explicit positive overrides remain admitted. DiscoveryTimeoutSeconds controls native HTTP request timeouts separately; native metadata retrieval may retry availability statuses.
